scope: CAMS (Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service) air-quality access verification via the Atmosphere Data Store (ADS), using the user's personal access token. Unlocks Data01 (airport pollutants) and Data15 (air quality).

evidence.name: CAMS European air quality forecasts — ensemble ANALYSIS (surface)
evidence.provider: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS), Atmosphere Data Store (ADS)
evidence.authentication: Personal access token (CAMS_API_KEY) accepted; account identity verified (email kept in .env, not recorded here). Licences accepted: cc-by (CC-BY-4.0) and Additional-licence-to-use-non-European-contributions.
evidence.schema_observation: netCDF classic: dims longitude(30) x latitude(35) x level(1) x time(1) over Ionian Islands bbox (19-22E, 37-40.5N); variables co_conc, no2_conc, pm10_conc, pm2p5_conc in ug/m3; ensemble model, surface level 0 m.
evidence.note: Sample values 2026-09-30 00:00Z analysis at Corfu airport grid point (39.65N, 19.95E): NO2 5.80, PM10 7.40, PM2.5 5.51, CO 158.70 ug/m3. Region max: NO2 8.07, PM10 16.82, PM2.5 10.11, CO 182.74 ug/m3. CO2 is NOT a CAMS regional output — Data01 'Airport CO2' has no direct CAMS CO2 variable; nearest airport-level pollutants are NO2/PM/CO (used as proxies), with CO2 deferred to CAMS global GHG (coarse) or local IoT sensors.

evidence.name: Nights spent at tourist accommodation establishments — NUTS3 (Ionian islands)
evidence.note: NUTS3 nights for EL621 Zakynthos, EL622 Kerkyra, EL623 Ithaki-Kefallinia, EL624 Lefkada, 2021-2025. Derives Data22 (1-HHI): 0.636/0.651/0.632/0.631/0.640.

evidence.name: Tourism capacity (bed-places) — NUTS3 (Ionian islands)
evidence.note: Access constraint, not 'source does not exist': tour_cap_nuts3 returns geo size 0 for all Greek NUTS3 codes (EL621-EL624, EL301) — Greece publishes bed-places only at NUTS2 (EL62). Data25 per-island capacity is therefore unavailable from Eurostat; next step ELSTAT municipality data or a nights-based proxy.

evidence.name: Capacity of hotels, similar establishments and tourist campsites (Table 1) — regional units
evidence.method: GET (edition page -> '01. Capacity' document link -> XLSX)
evidence.note: Ionian Islands bed-places (hotels+similar) by regional unit, 2021-2025: Kerkyra 49444->51413, Zakynthos 36696->39625, Kefallinia 11449->12041, Lefkada 5954->6221, Ithaki 265 (constant). Regional total 104108->109565. Granularity = regional unit (NUTS3), not municipality.
